chk_cadangan_tujuan.name: chk_cadangan_tujuan
chk_cadangan_tujuan.value:
(status_lokal is null or status_lokal in ('BERHASIL','GAGAL','NONAKTIF'))
        and (status_cloud is null or status_cloud in ('BERHASIL','GAGAL','NONAKTIF'))

chk_barang_konsinyasi.name: chk_barang_konsinyasi
chk_barang_konsinyasi.value:
(kepemilikan = 'MILIK_SENDIRI' and id_pemasok_konsinyasi is null and harga_titip is null)
        or (kepemilikan = 'KONSINYASI' and id_pemasok_konsinyasi is not null and harga_titip is not null and harga_titip >= 0)

chk_harga_isi.name: chk_harga_isi
chk_harga_isi.value:
(metode = 'IKUT_TIER' and markup_persen is null and harga_tetap is null)
        or (metode = 'MARKUP' and markup_persen is not null and harga_tetap is null)
        or (metode = 'TETAP' and harga_tetap is not null)

chk_jenis_atribut_dimensi.name: chk_jenis_atribut_dimensi
chk_jenis_atribut_dimensi.value: jenis_dimensi is null or jenis_dimensi in ('PANJANG','LUAS','VOLUME','BERAT','DAYA','JUMLAH','LAINNYA')

chk_promo_belanja_pelanggan.name: chk_promo_belanja_pelanggan
chk_promo_belanja_pelanggan.value:
(min_belanja_pelanggan is null and hari_belanja is null)
        or (min_belanja_pelanggan > 0 and hari_belanja between 1 and 3650)

chk_promo_nilai.name: chk_promo_nilai
chk_promo_nilai.value:
(jenis_potongan = 'PERSEN' and potongan_persen is not null and potongan_persen between 0 and 100 and potongan_nominal is null)
        or (jenis_potongan = 'NOMINAL' and potongan_nominal is not null and potongan_nominal >= 0 and potongan_persen is null)

chk_promo_sasaran.name: chk_promo_sasaran
chk_promo_sasaran.value:
(sasaran = 'SEMUA' and id_kategori is null and id_barang is null)
        or (sasaran = 'KATEGORI' and id_kategori is not null and id_barang is null)
        or (sasaran = 'BARANG' and id_barang is not null and id_kategori is null)

chk_tingkat_harga_min_belanja.name: chk_tingkat_harga_min_belanja
chk_tingkat_harga_min_belanja.value: min_belanja is null or (min_belanja > 0 and not is_default)

chk_tingkat_harga_aktif_bersyarat.name: chk_tingkat_harga_aktif_bersyarat
chk_tingkat_harga_aktif_bersyarat.value: is_default or min_belanja is not null or status_aktif = 'NONAKTIF'

chk_mutasi_qty.name: chk_mutasi_qty
chk_mutasi_qty.value: qty_masuk >= 0 and qty_keluar >= 0 and saldo_setelah >= 0 and hpp_satuan >= 0 and hpp_setelah >= 0

chk_mutasi_arah.name: chk_mutasi_arah
chk_mutasi_arah.value:
(jenis_mutasi in ('SALDO_AWAL','PENERIMAAN','RETUR_JUAL','VOID') and qty_masuk > 0 and qty_keluar = 0)
        or (jenis_mutasi in ('PENJUALAN','TUKAR_RETUR','RETUR_PEMASOK','MUSNAH') and qty_keluar > 0 and qty_masuk = 0)
        or (jenis_mutasi in ('PENYESUAIAN','PINDAH_KONDISI') and ((qty_masuk > 0 and qty_keluar = 0) or (qty_keluar > 0 and qty_masuk = 0)))

chk_mutasi_ref.name: chk_mutasi_ref
chk_mutasi_ref.value:
num_nonnulls(id_penerimaan_detail, id_penjualan_detail, id_retur_detail, id_void_detail, id_penyesuaian_detail, id_retur_pemasok_detail) = 1
        and (jenis_mutasi <> 'PENERIMAAN' or id_penerimaan_detail is not null)
        and (jenis_mutasi <> 'PENJUALAN' or id_penjualan_detail is not null)
        and (jenis_mutasi not in ('RETUR_JUAL','TUKAR_RETUR') or id_retur_detail is not null)
        and (jenis_mutasi <> 'VOID' or id_void_detail is not null)
        and (jenis_mutasi not in ('SALDO_AWAL','PENYESUAIAN','PINDAH_KONDISI','MUSNAH') or id_penyesuaian_detail is not null)
        and (jenis_mutasi <> 'RETUR_PEMASOK' or id_retur_pemasok_detail is not null)

chk_penerimaan_syarat.name: chk_penerimaan_syarat
chk_penerimaan_syarat.value:
(jenis = 'KONSINYASI' and syarat_bayar is null and tanggal_jatuh_tempo is null)
        or (jenis = 'PEMBELIAN' and syarat_bayar = 'TUNAI' and tanggal_jatuh_tempo is null)
        or (jenis = 'PEMBELIAN' and syarat_bayar = 'TEMPO' and tanggal_jatuh_tempo is not null)

chk_penerimaan_total.name: chk_penerimaan_total
chk_penerimaan_total.value:
total_faktur >= 0 and total_dibayar >= 0 and total_retur_potong >= 0
        and total_dibayar + total_retur_potong <= total_faktur

chk_penyesuaian_detail_kecuali.name: chk_penyesuaian_detail_kecuali
chk_penyesuaian_detail_kecuali.value: not dikecualikan or (alasan_kecuali is not null and id_pengguna_kecuali is not null and waktu_kecuali is not null)

chk_clerical_keterangan.name: chk_clerical_keterangan
chk_clerical_keterangan.value: uang_fisik = saldo_sistem or keterangan is not null

chk_clerical_nilai.name: chk_clerical_nilai
chk_clerical_nilai.value: modal_awal >= 0 and tunai_penjualan >= 0 and kas_masuk_lain >= 0 and kas_keluar >= 0 and uang_fisik >= 0

chk_order_pengantaran.name: chk_order_pengantaran
chk_order_pengantaran.value: jenis_penjualan = 'LANGSUNG' or (id_pelanggan is not null and alamat_kirim is not null)

chk_order_uang.name: chk_order_uang
chk_order_uang.value: ongkir >= 0 and subtotal >= 0 and diskon_transaksi >= 0 and total >= 0

chk_order_detail_harga.name: chk_order_detail_harga
chk_order_detail_harga.value: harga_satuan >= 0 and diskon_baris >= 0 and diskon_promo >= 0 and subtotal >= 0

chk_order_detail_tier.name: chk_order_detail_tier
chk_order_detail_tier.value: harga_manual or id_tingkat_harga is not null

chk_pembayaran_nominal.name: chk_pembayaran_nominal
chk_pembayaran_nominal.value: nominal > 0 and kembalian >= 0 and (uang_diterima is null or uang_diterima >= nominal)

chk_pembayaran_shift.name: chk_pembayaran_shift
chk_pembayaran_shift.value: metode <> 'TUNAI' or id_shift is not null

chk_penjualan_langsung.name: chk_penjualan_langsung
chk_penjualan_langsung.value:
(jenis_penjualan = 'LANGSUNG' and status_pengambilan in ('DIAMBIL','BELUM_DIAMBIL') and status_pengiriman is null)
        or (jenis_penjualan = 'PENGANTARAN' and status_pengiriman in ('BELUM','SEBAGIAN','SELESAI') and status_pengambilan is null
            and id_pelanggan is not null and alamat_kirim is not null)

chk_penjualan_uang.name: chk_penjualan_uang
chk_penjualan_uang.value:
total_bruto >= 0 and total_diskon >= 0 and diskon_transaksi >= 0 and ongkir >= 0
        and total_neto >= 0 and total_dibayar >= 0 and total_void >= 0 and total_retur >= 0
        and total_refund >= 0 and total_void + total_retur <= total_neto and total_refund <= total_dibayar

chk_penjualan_detail_harga.name: chk_penjualan_detail_harga
chk_penjualan_detail_harga.value: harga_satuan >= 0 and diskon_baris >= 0 and diskon_promo >= 0 and subtotal >= 0 and hpp_saat_transaksi >= 0

chk_penjualan_detail_tier.name: chk_penjualan_detail_tier
chk_penjualan_detail_tier.value: harga_manual or id_tingkat_harga is not null

chk_permintaan_persetujuan_rujukan.name: chk_permintaan_persetujuan_rujukan
chk_permintaan_persetujuan_rujukan.value: (jenis = 'RETUR' and id_retur is not null) or (jenis = 'VOID' and id_void is not null) or (jenis in ('LIMIT_KREDIT', 'UBAH_PELANGGAN') and id_pelanggan is not null)

chk_retur_cara.name: chk_retur_cara
chk_retur_cara.value:
(status = 'DISETUJUI') = (cara_persetujuan is not null)
        and (cara_persetujuan is null or cara_persetujuan in ('SENDIRI','AKUN_ATASAN','DI_TEMPAT','BATAS_BEBAS'))

chk_retur_detail_tukar.name: chk_retur_detail_tukar
chk_retur_detail_tukar.value:
num_nonnulls(id_barang_pengganti, qty_pengganti_dasar) in (0, 2)
        and (qty_pengganti_dasar is null or qty_pengganti_dasar > 0)

chk_void_cara.name: chk_void_cara
chk_void_cara.value:
(status = 'DISETUJUI') = (cara_persetujuan is not null)
        and (cara_persetujuan is null or cara_persetujuan in ('SENDIRI','AKUN_ATASAN','DI_TEMPAT','BATAS_BEBAS'))

chk_void_refund.name: chk_void_refund
chk_void_refund.value: metode_refund is null or metode_refund in ('TUNAI','TRANSFER')

chk_ksg_total.name: chk_ksg_total
chk_ksg_total.value: total >= 0 and total_dibayar >= 0 and total_dibayar <= total

chk_ksg_detail.name: chk_ksg_detail
chk_ksg_detail.value: qty_terjual >= 0 and qty_retur >= 0 and qty_ganti_rugi >= 0 and qty_neto >= 0 and harga_titip >= 0 and subtotal >= 0
